actual_response:
No, Otemachi Edge Center is not 100% renewable on an hour-by-hour basis for August. While their annual-style volumetric match is 110.4%, their true 24/7 hourly CFE score is 66% [tepco_retail_desk_demo.cfe_allocation_hourly, tepco_retail_desk_demo.grid_mix_hourly, tepco_retail_desk_demo.customers].

Here is the breakdown of their scores for August 1 to August 19:
* **Contracted Hourly-Matched Share:** 62% [tepco_retail_desk_demo.cfe_allocation_hourly, tepco_retail_desk_demo.grid_mix_hourly, tepco_retail_desk_demo.customers].
* **Grid Carbon-Free Contribution Share:** 4% [tepco_retail_desk_demo.cfe_allocation_hourly, tepco_retail_desk_demo.grid_mix_hourly, tepco_retail_desk_demo.customers].
* **Resulting 24/7 CFE Score:** 66% [tepco_retail_desk_demo.cfe_allocation_hourly, tepco_retail_desk_demo.grid_mix_hourly, tepco_retail_desk_demo.customers].
* **Annual-Style Volumetric Match:** 110.4% [tepco_retail_desk_demo.cfe_allocation_hourly, tepco_retail_desk_demo.grid_mix_hourly, tepco_retail_desk_demo.customers].

**Explanation of the Difference:**
Under volumetric accounting, their total contracted clean energy generated (11,930.9 MWh) exceeds their total metered load (10,803.7 MWh), resulting in a match above 100% [tepco_retail_desk_demo.cfe_allocation_hourly, tepco_retail_desk_demo.grid_mix_hourly, tepco_retail_desk_demo.customers]. 

However, under 24/7 hourly CFE matching, contracted clean generation is matched and capped against load on an hour-by-hour basis, meaning excess generation in peak hours cannot be rolled over to offset deficits in other hours [desk_policy_guide.md Section 8]. Across the period, 5,233.4 MWh of contracted clean power exceeded hourly consumption and was not counted toward the hourly match [tepco_retail_desk_demo.cfe_allocation_hourly, tepco_retail_desk_demo.grid_mix_hourly, tepco_retail_desk_demo.customers].

Their matching score is weakest during evening hours when solar generation drops off:
* **20:00-21:00:** 22.6% matched [tepco_retail_desk_demo.cfe_allocation_hourly, tepco_retail_desk_demo.grid_mix_hourly, tepco_retail_desk_demo.customers].
* **21:00-22:00:** 22.8% matched [tepco_retail_desk_demo.cfe_allocation_hourly, tepco_retail_desk_demo.grid_mix_hourly, tepco_retail_desk_demo.customers].
* **22:00-23:00:** 23.2% matched [tepco_retail_desk_demo.cfe_allocation_hourly, tepco_retail_desk_demo.grid_mix_hourly, tepco_retail_desk_demo.customers].
